meta.title: RepoChan · Brand Orchard — Sow a line of git, reap a brand
meta.description: RepoChan grows your git repository into a full brand kit: soil check, seed selection, sprout, sunlight, harvest and share. A solarpunk orchard landing page.

hero.sub: RepoChan is a CLI plus agent skills: it reads your repository, then grows a mascot, a foundation sheet, stickers and a landing page — the way a gardener tends an orchard.
hero.sceneAlt: Orchard at sunrise: RepoChan crouches watering a glowing sapling, a windmill and solar flowers in the distance

soil.title: Test the soil first
soil.note: repochan analysis runs a deterministic scan, then layers an LLM pre-analysis on top — like a soil test before sowing. The report lands in .repochan/analysis/.

cards.desc: Language and file distribution decide what this plot can grow.
Packages, frameworks and toolchains, classified automatically.
Commit cadence and active periods are the moisture of a repo.
Docs, license and conduct files shape how the orchard opens up.

soil.verdict: The soil report comes first; persona, commissions, painting and the site itself all cite it afterwards.

seed.title: Picking preferences, seed by seed
seed.note: The interview is not a form — it is seed selection. The Interviewer asks across 8 dimensions and dries your answers into a report that seeds everything after.

entries.a: A warm but reliable engineering companion
OSS maintainers on a brand sprint

entries.q: How loud should the mascot be?
entries.a: Medium — present, never louder than the product
A corner studio named Sugar Riff
Cel shading with warm everyday light

entries.q: Where does the name come from?

sprout.title: The seed breaks ground — and becomes her
sprout.note: World architect, character designer and consistency keeper work together, raising a living mascot out of the analysis and interview reports.
sprout.name: RepoChan, the Repo Keeper
sprout.catchphrase: "With a brush in hand, anywhere is my stage."

traits.desc: A gradient she dyed herself — unexpectedly great
Lake blue left, violet-pink right — her signature pair
Her visual signature. No reason, just love
Rock is fuel for drawing — and a force field

sprout.cutoutAlt: RepoChan as a gardener, watering a small potted sapling
sprout.cutoutCaption: Gardener form · tending every brand tree

sunframe.title: The foundation sheet is the sunframe
sunframe.note: The foundation sheet is a plaque nailed to the trunk: palette, poses and art style locked once. Every later commission grows under the same light and never warps.
sunframe.plaqueAlt: RepoChan foundation sheet: three views, palette and signature accessories

points.desc: Six colors written into the protocol, cited everywhere
Poses, accessories and keyMotifs on record
artStyle anchored: cel shading, warm everyday
Every asset order traces back to it

harvest.title: Ripe in batches, picked in batches
harvest.note: The art director issues every asset order up front; the Painter delivers them in dependency order. Stickers, web states, icons, posters — each fruit traceable by order id.
